Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.persistence

Class HealthcareAiCompanyEntity

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.persistence.HealthcareAiCompanyEntity
@Entity public class HealthcareAiCompanyEntity extends Object
JPA entity representing a row in the healthcare_ai_companies table.

Stores AI-in-healthcare company data discovered and enriched via the Perplexity API pipeline. Source URLs and validation sources are stored as pipe-delimited strings.
